sources.name: Adjusted Samurai Armor arm-guards (female)
sources.description: Nicolette D’Armstrong-Down also adjusted the arm-guards on the Samurai series of armor. The armor is laced with the patented ultra-weave, thus increasing the armors durability. The designer herself was seen at a fashion event wearing almost nothing but her own designs, making her the center of attention. The ultra-weave that covered the rest of her body was very much transparent, making it understandable why she stole the limelight.

sources.name: Angel Armor arm-guards (female)
sources.description: With the Angel-series armor, M&J have been accused of stealing Sollomates design for their Shadow series. It is also an interesting item for independent designers to copy. Whether this is true or not, the similarities are remarkable. Instead of the extravaganza found on the Shadow-armor, the Angel suit design and appearance is made to be as shiny, bright and pure as possible. This has attracted a lot of customers not ordinarily interested in wearing armor. The Angel armor is fashionable amongst the upper classes on Calypso.

sources.name: Chronicle Armor arm-guards (female)
sources.description: The Chronicle armor is a dedicated gladiator armor, used by the famous Earth gladiators. The armor is designed by the champion Pompeii Max, who still has the record of 221 matches, with no defeats. Several sets were imported to Calypso right before the robot wars, in an attempt to introduce the noble gladiator sport to the colony. This cut-resistant adm-alloy suit is very protective against most close combat attacks with edged weapons – even the feared Gladiator swords have difficulties inflicting serious damage to a wearer.

sources.name: Hunter Armor arm-guards (female)
sources.description: The Hunter-series of armor is a product designed by Sollomate for the would-be hunters on Calypso. It is also one of the most copied designs adapted by several small time local constructors. The armor is very flexible given its protection levels. Its fiber-plates are easily replaced when damaged. The color-scheme was developed with the natural scenery of Calypso in mind, increasing the wearers’ level of camouflage.

sources.name: Improved Hunter Armor arm-guards (female)
sources.description: One of the most common armors on Calypso, the venerable Hunter armor, was made in an anniversary edition to celebrate the Project Entropia venture. The designer of choice was Nicolette D’Armstrong-Down, who is responsible for several very successful altered armors. The improved Hunter arm-guards was a great success, with its fiber-resin inlays and very efficient cooling system that always keeps the wearer at a constant temperature. The reflective pseudo-camouflage layer of Samsadine™ enhances its protective abilities further. Although somewhat hard to find these days, it is still a very sought after armor, especially by women that hunts.

sources.name: Modified Shadow Armor arm-guards (female)
sources.description: The eccentric and flamboyant designer Di-Yomeran DeWille once made a very limited series of the exclusive Shadow armor. The Lucky Carcasses Mercenary League asked if DeWille was willing to produce 100 sets of modified Shadow armor for the Leagues member roster. DeWille accepted the challenge and began his brilliant work. The already superb Shadow armor got an extra layer of multi-reflexive BarrioMetronics™, a very rare liquid spray used on space vessels, and ordinarily not available outside military channels. The multi-alloys were injected with a liquid super coolant, making the parts very resistant to burn attacks. The entire armor set was also sprayed with the anti-corrosive NoAcidic™. Every suit of armor was handmade by Di-Yomeran DeWille and his trusted apprentices, taking several years to make. Unfortunately, just before DeWille was to begin manufacturing the Shadow helmets, he vanished into thin air. No one has ever seen him since. As the League later dispersed due to internal difficulties, several of these suits also went missing. Sometimes they turn up at different local marketplaces, sometimes on corpses in the wilderness of Calypso. One should know however, that this series of armor is truly exquisite and extremely rare to find.

sources.name: Sentinel Arm Guards (M,L)
sources.description: The Federal Empire launched several special operations teams during the end of the first robot war. These teams were equipped with the best armor the empire had available. Several troopers did however succumb as the armor lacked the vital protection against the robots' devastating laser fire. The teams, all members of the Grey Company of the SIF, or Special Incursion Forces, praised the armor's excellent projectile and impact resistance, as well as its ability to endure extensive punishment from shrapnel. Also in the instance of hand-to-hand combat the armor performed well, withstanding most close combat assaults.

Even if the design is very complex and advanced, this doesn’t stop the professional local armor manufacturers to make their own ‘Calypso Versions’ of this work of genius.

sources.name: Supremacy Arm Guards (F)
sources.description: The Supremacy armor is the next-generation protection of the well-known and respected Shadow armor series. Made by the same manufacturer, Supremacy offers a better protection level all over the board, with very few weaknesses. Its temperate super-alloy coating is a delight to see working together with the very comfortable shock-absorbers resting against the wearers body. The Supremacy's high production values will render it a spot among the higher echelon of armor suits, when great protection is an absolute necessity in order to survive.

sources.name: Vain Armor arm-guards (female)
sources.description: The Vain armor is an ancient and revered suit of armor from Earth. It was at first an exclusive suit designated to the Federal Imperial Righteous Guard. sources.name: Warrior Armor arm-guards (female)
sources.description: K’Ger made the Warrior armor as a response to Chikaras Dragon armor-design. The Warrior-series is a very well engineered piece of protection, based on an energy-absorbing super-alloy weave. Instead of marketing this armor as an exclusive suit, K’Ger aimed directly for people living in a hostile world – the mercenaries and guns-for-hire. This group often demands alterations, something Chikara does not acknowledge. This fact has made the Warrior a prime choice with several local armor constructors to copy and enhance, to facilitate the customer base.

sources.name: Hunter Armor face-guard (female)
sources.description: The Hunter-series of armor is a product designed by Sollomate for the would-be hunters on Calypso. It is also one of the most copied designs adapted by several small time local constructors. The armor is very flexible given its protection levels. Its fiber-plates are easily replaced when damaged. The color-scheme was developed with the natural scenery of Calypso in mind, increasing the wearers’ level of camouflage.

sources.name: Improved Hunter Armor face-guard (female)
sources.description: One of the most common armors on Calypso, the venerable Hunter armor, was made in an anniversary edition to celebrate the Project Entropia venture. The designer of choice was Nicolette D’Armstrong-Down, who is responsible for several very successful altered armors. The improved Hunter face-guard was a great success, with its fiber-resin inlays and very efficient cooling system that always keeps the wearer at a constant temperature. The reflective pseudo-camouflage layer of Samsadine™ enhances its protective abilities further. Although somewhat hard to find these days, it is still a very sought after armor, especially by women that hunt.

sources.name: Improved Paladin Armor face-guard (male)
sources.description: Liam Marcus did utilize the MaxiAlloy to upgrade this face-guard in an attempt to increase the volume of the MaxiAlloy production. The final product offers a very sturdy and reliable protection, once again putting the Liam Marcus Firm of Comfortable Protections at the top end of armor engineering. The use of MaxiAlloy became too expensive however, and the production of the improved Paladin face-guards stopped after just a few thousand units, making this armor scarce.

sources.name: Improved Shogun Armor face-guard (male)
sources.description: Protecting ones face is important, and its more physical aspects are something that LM/FCP decided to deal with. The Liam Marcus Firm of Comfortable Protections added a layer of MaxiAlloy-weave, surrounded by a TwinFiber Super-line. The result was remarkable, and was very well received. Unfortunately, the process of refining the MaxiAlloy did make the face-guards very expensive, which in turn killed production after only a short while. This makes the improved Shogun face-guard a rare item.

sources.description: The K’Ger Knight-series is a great set of armor, made to be the best you can get while utilizing standard manufacturing methods. This hasn’t stopped the customizers on Calypso to make their own versions of this armor. The armor is somewhat bulky and rigid, but its protection level is significant. This combined with a design that has won several prestigious prizes has made the Knight-series a true contender in the elite segment of armors.

sources.name: Warrior Armor face-guard (female)
sources.description: K’Ger made the Warrior armor as a response to Chikaras Dragon armor-design. The Warrior-series is a very well engineered piece of protection, based on an energy-absorbing super-alloy weave. Instead of marketing this armor as an exclusive suit, K’Ger aimed directly for people living in a hostile world – the mercenaries and guns-for-hire. This group often demands alterations, something Chikara does not acknowledge. This fact has made the Warrior a prime choice with several local armor constructors to copy and enhance, to facilitate the customer base.

sources.name: Angel Foot Guards (F)
sources.description: With the Angel-series armor, M&J have been accused of stealing Sollomates design for their Shadow series. It is also an interesting item for independent designers to copy. Whether this is true or not, the similarities are remarkable. Instead of the extravaganza found on the Shadow-armor, the Angel suit design and appearance is made to be as shiny, bright and pure as possible. This has attracted a lot of customers not ordinarily interested in wearing armor. The Angel armor is fashionable amongst the upper classes on Calypso.

It is also one of the most copied designs adapted by several small time local constructors. The armor is very flexible given its protection levels. Its fiber-plates are easily replaced when damaged. The color-scheme was developed with the natural scenery of Calypso in mind, increasing the wearers' level of camouflage.

This hasn't stopped the customizers on Calypso to make their own versions of this armor. The armor is somewhat bulky and rigid, but its protection level is significant. This combined with a design that has won several prestigious prizes has made the Knight-series a true contender in the elite segment of armors.

sources.name: Protector of the Empire Foot Guards (M)
sources.description: The Protector of the Empire armor suit is a rare honorary armor awarded by the Empire to valiant heroes in times of war. With its distinctive look and great protection, this prestigious armor is a coveted item for any warrior. Very few suits have ever made it to Calypso, and haven’t been awarded to anyone since the battle of Yadayat in the Baltran system.

sources.name: Settler Foot Guards (F)
sources.description: The DuraTekk Settler armor is a common sight on Calypso. It is cheap and versatile. Every citizen that has any notion about venturing out into the wilderness should have this armor at least. DuraTekk is distraught by the fact that the Settler is one of the most copied designs ever on Calypso, due to its ease to manufacture locally.

sources.name: Shadow Foot Guards (F)
sources.description: The Shadow-series is nothing less than an example of Sollomates engineering genius. The dark camouflage, together with its terrific protection level and flexible materials, makes this one of the most advanced piece of armor on Calypso. Everything about it oozes perfection – the multi-layered liquid fiber-weave interwoven with high-density multi-alloys is just truly state-of-the-art. Even if the design is very complex and advanced, this doesn't stop the professional local armor manufacturers to make their own ‘Calypso Versions' of this work of genius.

This has also spawn several pirate designs of the Shogun suite, some local customize experts even makes superior versions.

sources.name: Vain Foot Guards (F)
sources.description: The Vain armor is an ancient and revered suit of armor from Earth. It was at first an exclusive suit designated to the Federal Imperial Righteous Guard. It is very effective against projectile and close combat attacks, as these were the dominant weapon types that existed at this time. Former Federal Calypso Minister Xavyir Rugarnia's personal bodyguard brought a few examples of this armor to Calypso. Also, a few of the old noble families from before the first robot war obtained their own sets, to show off their status on the new world. Most of the armor sets were lost during the war and the ravaging robots destroyed many suits.

sources.name: Warrior Foot Guards (F)
sources.description: K'Ger made the Warrior armor as a response to Chikaras Dragon armor-design. The Warrior-series is a very well engineered piece of protection, based on an energy-absorbing super-alloy weave. Instead of marketing this armor as an exclusive suit, K'Ger aimed directly for people living in a hostile world – the mercenaries and guns-for-hire. This group often demands alterations, something Chikara does not acknowledge. This fact has made the Warrior a prime choice with several local armor constructors to copy and enhance, to facilitate the customer base.

sources.name: Adjusted Samurai Armor gloves (female)
sources.description: This pair of gloves follows the same principles as the Samurai harness, also adjusted by Nicolette D’Armstrong-Down. This brilliant designer managed to elongate the finger pieces, thus allowing for longer finger nails, a function requested by the all-female mercenary group Goddesses of Death, whose fashion statement is as important for them as their reputation as top notch professionals. The gloves use the same ultra-weave cover as the rest of D’Armstrong-Down’s adjusted Samurai series.

sources.name: Angel Armor gloves (female)
sources.description: With the Angel-series armor, M&J have been accused of stealing Sollomates design for their Shadow series. It is also an interesting item for independent designers to copy. Whether this is true or not, the similarities are remarkable. Instead of the extravaganza found on the Shadow-armor, the Angel suit design and appearance is made to be as shiny, bright and pure as possible. This has attracted a lot of customers not ordinarily interested in wearing armor. The Angel armor is fashionable amongst the upper classes on Calypso.

sources.name: Chronicle Gloves (F,L)
sources.description: The Chronicle armor is a dedicated gladiator armor, used by the famous Earth gladiators. The armor is designed by the champion Pompeii Max, who still has the record of 221 matches, with no defeats. Several sets were imported to Calypso right before the robot wars, in an attempt to introduce the noble gladiator sport to the colony. This cut-resistant adm-alloy suit is very protective against most close combat attacks with edged weapons – even the feared Gladiator swords have difficulties inflicting serious damage to a wearer.

sources.name: Hunter Armor gloves (female)
sources.description: The Hunter-series of armor is a product designed by Sollomate for the would-be hunters on Calypso. It is also one of the most copied designs adapted by several small time local constructors. The armor is very flexible given its protection levels. Its fiber-plates are easily replaced when damaged. The color-scheme was developed with the natural scenery of Calypso in mind, increasing the wearers’ level of camouflage.

sources.name: Improved Hunter Armor gloves (female)
sources.description: One of the most common armors on Calypso, the venerable Hunter armor, was made in an anniversary edition to celebrate the Project Entropia venture. The designer of choice was Nicolette D’Armstrong-Down, who is responsible for several very successful altered armors. The improved Hunter gloves was a great success, with its fiber-resin inlays and very efficient cooling system that always keeps the wearer at a constant temperature. The reflective pseudo-camouflage layer of Samsadine™ enhances its protective abilities further. Although somewhat hard to find these days, it is still a very sought after armor, especially by women that hunt.

sources.name: Knight Armor gloves (female)
sources.description: The K’Ger Knight-series is a great set of armor, made to be the best you can get while utilizing standard manufacturing methods. This hasn’t stopped the customizers on Calypso to make their own versions of this armor. The armor is somewhat bulky and rigid, but its protection level is significant. This combined with a design that has won several prestigious prizes has made the Knight-series a true contender in the elite segment of armors.

sources.name: Modified Shadow Armor gloves (female)
sources.description: The eccentric and flamboyant designer Di-Yomeran DeWille once made a very limited series of the exclusive Shadow armor. The Lucky Carcasses Mercenary League asked if DeWille was willing to produce 100 sets of modified Shadow armor for the Leagues member roster. DeWille accepted the challenge and began his brilliant work. The already superb Shadow armor got an extra layer of multi-reflexive BarrioMetronics™, a very rare liquid spray used on space vessels, and ordinarily not available outside military channels. The multi-alloys were injected with a liquid super coolant, making the parts very resistant to burn attacks. The entire armor set was also sprayed with the anti-corrosive NoAcidic™. Every suit of armor was handmade by Di-Yomeran DeWille and his trusted apprentices, taking several years to make. Unfortunately, just before DeWille was to begin manufacturing the Shadow helmets, he vanished into thin air. No one has ever seen him since. As the League later dispersed due to internal difficulties, several of these suits also went missing. Sometimes they turn up at different local marketplaces, sometimes on corpses in the wilderness of Calypso. One should know however, that this series of armor is truly exquisite and extremely rare to find.

sources.name: Nemesis Armor gloves (female)
sources.description: Nemesis is certainly the correct name for this well-made armor-suite. It is a hyper-modern protection, offering high protection levels and a comfortable fit, as can be expected when M&J is the designer. This statement is also enhanced by the attempts by local armor constructors to copy and enhance this masterpiece. The armor is made from different layers of flexible composite plates over a semi-flexible absorbing fabric.

sources.name: Sentinel Armor gloves (male)
sources.description: The Federal Empire launched several special operations teams during the end of the first robot war. These teams were equipped with the best armor the empire had available. Several troopers did however succumb as the armor lacked the vital protection against the robots’ devastating laser fire. The teams, all members of the Grey Company of the SIF, or Special Incursion Forces, praised the armor’s excellent projectile and impact resistance, as well as its ability to endure extensive punishment from shrapnel. Also in the instance of hand-to-hand combat the armor performed well, withstanding most close combat assaults.

sources.description: The DuraTekk Settler armor is a common sight on Calypso. It is cheap and versatile. Every citizen that has any notion about venturing out into the wilderness should have this armor at least. DuraTekk is distraught by the fact that the Settler is one of the most copied designs ever on Calypso, due to its ease to manufacture locally.

sources.name: Shadow Armor gloves (female)
sources.description: The Shadow-series is nothing less than an example of Sollomates engineering genius. The dark camouflage, together with its terrific protection level and flexible materials, makes this one of the most advanced piece of armor on Calypso. Everything about it oozes perfection – the multi-layered liquid fiber-weave interwoven with high-density multi-alloys is just truly state-of-the-art. Even if the design is very complex and advanced, this doesn’t stop the professional local armor manufacturers to make their own ‘Calypso Versions’ of this work of genius.

Several neo-designs have also been utilized when designing this masterpiece in armor technology. Its popularity is far greater than its availability on Calypso. This has also spawn several pirate designs of the Shogun suite, some local customize experts even makes superior versions.

sources.description: The Supremacy armor is the next-generation protection of the well-known and respected Shadow armor series. Made by the same manufacturer, Supremacy offers a better protection level all over the board, with very few weaknesses. Its temperate super-alloy coating is a delight to see working together with the very comfortable shock-absorbers resting against the wearers body. The Supremacy's high production values will render it a spot among the higher echelon of armor suits, when great protection is an absolute necessity in order to survive.

sources.name: Vain Gloves (F,L)
sources.description: The Vain armor is an ancient and revered suit of armor from Earth. It was at first an exclusive suit designated to the Federal Imperial Righteous Guard. It is very effective against projectile and close combat attacks, as these were the dominant weapon types that existed at this time. Former Federal Calypso Minister Xavyir Rugarnia's personal bodyguard brought a few examples of this armor to Calypso. Also, a few of the old noble families from before the first robot war obtained their own sets, to show off their status on the new world. Most of the armor sets were lost during the war and the ravaging robots destroyed many suits.

sources.name: Warrior Armor gloves (female)
sources.description: K’Ger made the Warrior armor as a response to Chikaras Dragon armor-design. The Warrior-series is a very well engineered piece of protection, based on an energy-absorbing super-alloy weave. Instead of marketing this armor as an exclusive suit, K’Ger aimed directly for people living in a hostile world – the mercenaries and guns-for-hire. This group often demands alterations, something Chikara does not acknowledge. This fact has made the Warrior a prime choice with several local armor constructors to copy and enhance, to facilitate the customer base.

It also has an air-cooling channel system interwoven in the ballistic underfabric.

sources.name: Adjusted Samurai Armor harness (female)
sources.description: The former CSF-commander Nicolette D’Armstrong-Down changed career to become an armor constructor, specializing in women’s needs. Her armor designs are always very comfortable and easy to wear. This harness, originally a Chikara design has a completely new lining and an ultra-weave that further enhances its durability. The design has won several awards for D’Armstrong-Down, who is something of a celebrity on Calypso. She is also a frequent target of gossip, as she still is single.

This armor is padded with an extra layer of liquid quasi-fibers, making it more resilient to burn-attacks in particular.

sources.name: Angel Armor harness (female)
sources.description: With the Angel-series armor, M&J have been accused of stealing Sollomates design for their Shadow series. It is also an interesting item for independent designers to copy. Whether this is true or not, the similarities are remarkable. Instead of the extravaganza found on the Shadow-armor, the Angel suit design and appearance is made to be as shiny, bright and pure as possible. This has attracted a lot of customers not ordinarily interested in wearing armor. The Angel armor is fashionable amongst the upper classes on Calypso.

sources.name: Chronicle Armor harness (female)
sources.description: The Chronicle armor is a dedicated gladiator armor, used by the famous Earth gladiators. The armor is designed by the champion Pompeii Max, who still has the record of 221 matches, with no defeats. Several sets were imported to Calypso right before the robot wars, in an attempt to introduce the noble gladiator sport to the colony. This cut-resistant adm-alloy suit is very protective against most close combat attacks with edged weapons – even the feared Gladiator swords have difficulties inflicting serious damage to a wearer.

sources.name: Hunter Armor harness (female)
sources.description: The Hunter-series of armor is a product designed by Sollomate for the would-be hunters on Calypso. It is also one of the most copied designs adapted by several small time local constructors. The armor is very flexible given its protection levels. Its fiber-plates are easily replaced when damaged. The color-scheme was developed with the natural scenery of Calypso in mind, increasing the wearers’ level of camouflage.

sources.name: Improved Hunter Armor harness (female)
sources.description: One of the most common armors on Calypso, the venerable Hunter armor, was made in an anniversary edition to celebrate the Project Entropia venture. The designer of choice was Nicolette D’Armstrong-Down, who is responsible for several very successful altered armors. The improved Hunter harness was a great success, with its fiber-resin inlays and very efficient cooling system that always keeps the wearer at a constant temperature. The reflective pseudo-camouflage layer of Samsadine™ enhances its protective abilities further. Although somewhat hard to find these days, it is still a very sought after armor, especially by women that hunts.

sources.name: Improved Paladin Armor harness (female)
sources.description: Liam Marcus did utilize the MaxiAlloy to upgrade this harness in an attempt to increase the volume of the MaxiAlloy production. The final product offers a very sturdy and reliable protection, once again putting the Liam Marcus Firm of Comfortable Protections at the top end of armor engineering. The use of MaxiAlloy became too expensive however, and the production of the improved Paladin harness stopped after just a few thousand units, making this armor scarce.

sources.name: Improved Shogun Armor harness (female)
sources.description: Protecting ones chest is important, and its more physical aspects are something that LM/FCP decided to deal with. The Liam Marcus Firm of Comfortable Protections added a layer of MaxiAlloy-weave, surrounded by a TwinFiber Super-line. The result was remarkable, and very well received. Unfortunately, the process of refining the MaxiAlloy did make the harness very expensive, which in turn killed production after only a short while. This makes the improved Shogun harness a rare item.

sources.name: Improved Vigilante Armor harness (female)
sources.description: The ever-resilient designer Nicolette D’Armstrong-Down is the designer behind this armor, which also doubles as a fashion garment. The original Vigilante harness is a very good piece of armor, and has appeared in different media and on the catwalks. The improved version is even more than that. The armor is provided with very comfortable multi-foam that supplies an instant body-fit to the wearer. The collar of the armor includes several inlaid rubies, all in a  special ‘D’Armstrong cut’. Every wearer also gets their name etched in a platinum plate wherever they desire.

sources.name: Modified Shadow Armor harness (female)
sources.description: The eccentric and flamboyant designer Di-Yomeran DeWille once made a very limited series of the exclusive Shadow armor. The Lucky Carcasses Mercenary League asked if DeWille was willing to produce 100 sets of modified Shadow armor for the Leagues member roster. DeWille accepted the challenge and began his brilliant work. The already superb Shadow armor got an extra layer of multi-reflexive BarrioMetronics™, a very rare liquid spray used on space vessels, and ordinarily not available outside military channels. The multi-alloys were injected with a liquid super coolant, making the parts very resistant to burn attacks. The entire armor set was also sprayed with the anti-corrosive NoAcidic™. Every suit of armor was handmade by Di-Yomeran DeWille and his trusted apprentices, taking several years to make. Unfortunately, just before DeWille was to begin manufacturing the Shadow helmets, he vanished into thin air. No one has ever seen him since. As the League later dispersed due to internal difficulties, several of these suits also went missing. Sometimes they turn up at different local marketplaces, sometimes on corpses in the wilderness of Calypso. One should know however, that this series of armor is truly exquisite and extremely rare to find.

It is a hyper-modern protection, offering high protection levels and a comfortable fit, as can be expected when M&J is the designer. The armor is made from different layers of flexible composite plates over a semi-flexible absorbing fabric.

Very few suits have ever made it to Calypso, and haven’t been awarded to anyone since the battle of Yadayat in the Baltran system.

sources.name: Sentinel Armor harness (female)
sources.description: The Federal Empire launched several special operations teams during the end of the first robot war. These teams were equipped with the best armor the empire had available. Several troopers did however succumb as the armor lacked the vital protection against the robots’ devastating laser fire. The teams, all members of the Grey Company of the SIF, or Special Incursion Forces, praised the armor’s excellent projectile and impact resistance, as well as its ability to endure extensive punishment from shrapnel. Also in the instance of hand-to-hand combat the armor performed well, withstanding most close combat assaults.

sources.description: The DuraTekk Settler armor is a common sight on Calypso. It is cheap and versatile. Every citizen that has any notion about venturing out into the wilderness should have this armor at least. DuraTekk is distraught by the fact that the Settler is one of the most copied designs ever on Calypso, due to its ease to manufacture locally.

sources.name: Shadow Armor harness (female)
sources.description: The Shadow-series is nothing less than an example of Sollomates engineering genius. The dark camouflage, together with its terrific protection level and flexible materials, makes this one of the most advanced piece of armor on Calypso. Everything about it oozes perfection – the multi-layered liquid fiber-weave interwoven with high-density multi-alloys is just truly state-of-the-art. Even if the design is very complex and advanced, this doesn’t stop the professional local armor manufacturers to make their own ‘Calypso Versions’ of this work of genius.

Several neo-designs have also been utilized when designing this masterpiece in armor technology. Its popularity is far greater than its availability on Calypso. This has also spawn several pirate designs of the Shogun suite, some local customize experts even makes superior versions.

sources.name: Supremacy Harness (F)
sources.description: The Supremacy armor is the next-generation protection of the well-known and respected Shadow armor series. Made by the same manufacturer, Supremacy offers a better protection level all over the board, with very few weaknesses. Its temperate super-alloy coating is a delight to see working together with the very comfortable shock-absorbers resting against the wearers body. The Supremacy's high production values will render it a spot among the higher echelon of armor suits, when great protection is an absolute necessity in order to survive.

sources.name: Vain Armor harness (female)
sources.description: The Vain armor is an ancient and revered suit of armor from Earth. It was at first an exclusive suit designated to the Federal Imperial Righteous Guard. It is very effective against projectile and close combat attacks, as these were the dominant weapon types that existed at this time. Former Federal Calypso Minister Xavyir Rugarnia’s personal bodyguard brought a few examples of this armor to Calypso. Also, a few of the old noble families from before the first robot war obtained their own sets, to show off their status on the new world. Most of the armor sets were lost during the war and the ravaging robots destroyed many suits.

sources.name: Vigilante Armor harness (female)
sources.description: The M&J Vigilante is a heavy set of strong armor made to be resilient against all forms of attack. The rigid construction, with a simple, yet innovative design has made the armor renowned in the more fashionable spheres of armor construction. Due to the basic construction, it had also been subject to massive copying by local Calypso armor manufacturers.

sources.name: Warrior Armor harness (female)
sources.description: K’Ger made the Warrior armor as a response to Chikaras Dragon armor-design. The Warrior-series is a very well engineered piece of protection, based on an energy-absorbing super-alloy weave. Instead of marketing this armor as an exclusive suit, K’Ger aimed directly for people living in a hostile world – the mercenaries and guns-for-hire. This group often demands alterations, something Chikara does not acknowledge. This fact has made the Warrior a prime choice with several local armor constructors to copy and enhance, to facilitate the customer base.

sources.name: Angel Armor helmet (female)
sources.description: With the Angel-series armor, M&J have been accused of stealing Sollomates design for their Shadow series. It is also an interesting item for independent designers to copy. Whether this is true or not, the similarities are remarkable. Instead of the extravaganza found on the Shadow-armor, the Angel suit design and appearance is made to be as shiny, bright and pure as possible. This has attracted a lot of customers not ordinarily interested in wearing armor. The Angel armor is fashionable amongst the upper classes on Calypso.

sources.name: Chronicle Armor helmet (female)
sources.description: The Chronicle armor is a dedicated gladiator armor, used by the famous Earth gladiators. The armor is designed by the champion Pompeii Max, who still has the record of 221 matches, with no defeats. Several sets were imported to Calypso right before the robot wars, in an attempt to introduce the noble gladiator sport to the colony. This cut-resistant adm-alloy suit is very protective against most close combat attacks with edged weapons – even the feared Gladiator swords have difficulties inflicting serious damage to a wearer.

The armor is designed by the champion Pompeii Max, who still has the record of 221 matches, with no defeats. Several sets were imported to Calypso right before the robot wars, in an attempt to introduce the noble gladiator sport to the colony. This cut-resistant adm-alloy suit is very protective against most close combat attacks with edged weapons – even the feared Gladiator swords have difficulties inflicting serious damage to a wearer.

sources.name: Improved Angel Armor helmet (male)
sources.description: The Angel series by Masterii & Jones is considered a very good armor suite. The story goes that the genius/madman Dr Turuc Urbani fell in love with the shape and color of the exquisite Angel series helmet. He then decided that he wanted to do his own line of Angel helmets, to which he got permission to do so by M&J. The limited series of the improved Angel helmets have a Reflox-coated visor, with a padded version of the liquid quasi-fibers, enhancing its protection further. The surface of the helmet is laced with the super-shining effect of Diamond polish, and the inner protection lining has also been replaced with a super-shock-absorbing material known as Absobler™.

sources.name: Nemesis Armor helmet (female)
sources.description: Nemesis is certainly the correct name for this well-made armor-suite. It is a hyper-modern protection, offering high protection levels and a comfortable fit, as can be expected when M&J is the designer. This statement is also enhanced by the attempts by local armor constructors to copy and enhance this masterpiece. The armor is made from different layers of flexible composite plates over a semi-flexible absorbing fabric.

sources.description: The Protector of the Empire armor suit is a rare honorary armor awarded by the Empire to valiant heroes in times of war. With its distinctive look and great protection, this prestigious armor is a coveted item for any warrior. Very few suits have ever made it to Calypso, and haven’t been awarded to anyone since the battle of Yadayat in the Baltran system.

sources.name: Sentinel Armor helmet (female)
sources.description: The Federal Empire launched several special operations teams during the end of the first robot war. These teams were equipped with the best armor the empire had available. Several troopers did however succumb as the armor lacked the vital protection against the robots’ devastating laser fire. The teams, all members of the Grey Company of the SIF, or Special Incursion Forces, praised the armor’s excellent projectile and impact resistance, as well as its ability to endure extensive punishment from shrapnel. Also in the instance of hand-to-hand combat the armor performed well, withstanding most close combat assaults.

sources.name: Shadow Armor helmet (female)
sources.description: The Shadow-series is nothing less than an example of Sollomates engineering genius. The dark camouflage, together with its terrific protection level and flexible materials, makes this one of the most advanced piece of armor on Calypso. Everything about it oozes perfection – the multi-layered liquid fiber-weave interwoven with high-density multi-alloys is just truly state-of-the-art. Even if the design is very complex and advanced, this doesn’t stop the professional local armor manufacturers to make their own ‘Calypso Versions’ of this work of genius.

sources.name: Supremacy Helmet (F)
sources.description: The Supremacy armor is the next-generation protection of the well-known and respected Shadow armor series. Made by the same manufacturer, Supremacy offers a better protection level all over the board, with very few weaknesses. Its temperate super-alloy coating is a delight to see working together with the very comfortable shock-absorbers resting against the wearers body. The Supremacy's high production values will render it a spot among the higher echelon of armor suits, when great protection is an absolute necessity in order to survive.

sources.name: Vain Armor helmet (female)
sources.description: The Vain armor is an ancient and revered suit of armor from Earth. It was at first an exclusive suit designated to the Federal Imperial Righteous Guard. It is very effective against projectile and close combat attacks, as these were the dominant weapon types that existed at this time. Former Federal Calypso Minister Xavyir Rugarnia’s personal bodyguard brought a few examples of this armor to Calypso. Also, a few of the old noble families from before the first robot war obtained their own sets, to show off their status on the new world. Most of the armor sets were lost during the war and the ravaging robots destroyed many suits.

Former Federal Calypso Minister Xavyir Rugarnia's personal bodyguard brought a few examples of this armor to Calypso. Also, a few of the old noble families from before the first robot war obtained their own sets, to show off their status on the new world. Most of the armor sets were lost during the war and the ravaging robots destroyed many suits.

Due to the basic construction, it had also been subject to massive copying by local Calypso armor manufacturers.

sources.name: Angel Armor shin-guards (female)
sources.description: With the Angel-series armor, M&J have been accused of stealing Sollomates design for their Shadow series. It is also an interesting item for independent designers to copy. Whether this is true or not, the similarities are remarkable. Instead of the extravaganza found on the Shadow-armor, the Angel suit design and appearance is made to be as shiny, bright and pure as possible. This has attracted a lot of customers not ordinarily interested in wearing armor. The Angel armor is fashionable amongst the upper classes on Calypso.

sources.name: Chronicle Armor shin-guards (female)
sources.description: The Chronicle armor is a dedicated gladiator armor, used by the famous Earth gladiators. The armor is designed by the champion Pompeii Max, who still has the record of 221 matches, with no defeats. Several sets were imported to Calypso right before the robot wars, in an attempt to introduce the noble gladiator sport to the colony. This cut-resistant adm-alloy suit is very protective against most close combat attacks with edged weapons – even the feared Gladiator swords have difficulties inflicting serious damage to a wearer.

sources.name: Hunter Armor shin-guards (female)
sources.description: The Hunter-series of armor is a product designed by Sollomate for the would-be hunters on Calypso. It is also one of the most copied designs adapted by several small time local constructors. The armor is very flexible given its protection levels. Its fiber-plates are easily replaced when damaged. The color-scheme was developed with the natural scenery of Calypso in mind, increasing the wearers’ level of camouflage.

This hasn’t stopped the customizers on Calypso to make their own versions of this armor. The armor is somewhat bulky and rigid, but its protection level is significant. This combined with a design that has won several prestigious prizes has made the Knight-series a true contender in the elite segment of armors.

sources.name: Modified Shadow Armor shin-guards (female)
sources.description: The eccentric and flamboyant designer Di-Yomeran DeWille once made a very limited series of the exclusive Shadow armor. The Lucky Carcasses Mercenary League asked if DeWille was willing to produce 100 sets of modified Shadow armor for the Leagues member roster. DeWille accepted the challenge and began his brilliant work. The already superb Shadow armor got an extra layer of multi-reflexive BarrioMetronics™, a very rare liquid spray used on space vessels, and ordinarily not available outside military channels. The multi-alloys were injected with a liquid super coolant, making the parts very resistant to burn attacks. The entire armor set was also sprayed with the anti-corrosive NoAcidic™. Every suit of armor was handmade by Di-Yomeran DeWille and his trusted apprentices, taking several years to make. Unfortunately, just before DeWille was to begin manufacturing the Shadow helmets, he vanished into thin air. No one has ever seen him since. As the League later dispersed due to internal difficulties, several of these suits also went missing. Sometimes they turn up at different local marketplaces, sometimes on corpses in the wilderness of Calypso. One should know however, that this series of armor is truly exquisite and extremely rare to find.

sources.name: Nemesis Armor shin-guards (female)
sources.description: Nemesis is certainly the correct name for this well-made armor-suite. It is a hyper-modern protection, offering high protection levels and a comfortable fit, as can be expected when M&J is the designer. This statement is also enhanced by the attempts by local armor constructors to copy and enhance this masterpiece. The armor is made from different layers of flexible composite plates over a semi-flexible absorbing fabric.

sources.name: Sentinel Armor shin-guards (female)
sources.description: The Federal Empire launched several special operations teams during the end of the first robot war. These teams were equipped with the best armor the empire had available. Several troopers did however succumb as the armor lacked the vital protection against the robots’ devastating laser fire. The teams, all members of the Grey Company of the SIF, or Special Incursion Forces, praised the armor’s excellent projectile and impact resistance, as well as its ability to endure extensive punishment from shrapnel. Also in the instance of hand-to-hand combat the armor performed well, withstanding most close combat assaults.

sources.name: Shadow Armor shin-guards (female)
sources.description: The Shadow-series is nothing less than an example of Sollomates engineering genius. The dark camouflage, together with its terrific protection level and flexible materials, makes this one of the most advanced piece of armor on Calypso. Everything about it oozes perfection – the multi-layered liquid fiber-weave interwoven with high-density multi-alloys is just truly state-of-the-art. Even if the design is very complex and advanced, this doesn’t stop the professional local armor manufacturers to make their own ‘Calypso Versions’ of this work of genius.

Even if the design is very complex and advanced, this doesn't stop the professional local armor manufacturers to make their own ‘Calypso Versions' of this work of genius.

sources.name: Supremacy Shin Guards (F)
sources.description: The Supremacy armor is the next-generation protection of the well-known and respected Shadow armor series. Made by the same manufacturer, Supremacy offers a better protection level all over the board, with very few weaknesses. Its temperate super-alloy coating is a delight to see working together with the very comfortable shock-absorbers resting against the wearers body. The Supremacy's high production values will render it a spot among the higher echelon of armor suits, when great protection is an absolute necessity in order to survive.

sources.name: Vain Armor shin-guards (female)
sources.description: The Vain armor is an ancient and revered suit of armor from Earth. It was at first an exclusive suit designated to the Federal Imperial Righteous Guard. It is very effective against projectile and close combat attacks, as these were the dominant weapon types that existed at this time. Former Federal Calypso Minister Xavyir Rugarnia’s personal bodyguard brought a few examples of this armor to Calypso. Also, a few of the old noble families from before the first robot war obtained their own sets, to show off their status on the new world. Most of the armor sets were lost during the war and the ravaging robots destroyed many suits.

sources.name: Warrior Armor shin-guards (female)
sources.description: K’Ger made the Warrior armor as a response to Chikaras Dragon armor-design. The Warrior-series is a very well engineered piece of protection, based on an energy-absorbing super-alloy weave. Instead of marketing this armor as an exclusive suit, K’Ger aimed directly for people living in a hostile world – the mercenaries and guns-for-hire. This group often demands alterations, something Chikara does not acknowledge. This fact has made the Warrior a prime choice with several local armor constructors to copy and enhance, to facilitate the customer base.

sources.name: Adjusted Samurai Armor thigh-guard (female)
sources.description: The armor constructor Nicolette D’Armstrong-Down armor designs are always very comfortable and easy to wear. The thigh-guards, originally a Chikara design received a completely new lining and an ultra-weave that further enhances its durability. The cooling fabric has also beenenhanced somewhat, making them even more comfortable to wear. This set is also one of the few that the famous constructor made for both sexes. D’Armstrong-Down is something of a celebrity on Calypso. She is also a frequent target of gossip, as she is still single.

sources.name: Adjusted Settler Armor thigh-guards (female)
sources.description: After the success with the harness Dr Turuc Urbani made an adjustment to the venerable Settler thigh-guards. This time both the male and the female versions recieved a real overhaul, with priority given to its fit. Dr Urbani made the armor much more streamlined for different body types, thus making it comfortable for almost everyone. The armor is also padded with an extra layer of liquid quasi-fibers, making it more resilient to burn-attacks in particular.

sources.name: Angel Armor thigh-guards (female)
sources.description: With the Angel-series armor, M&J have been accused of stealing Sollomates design for their Shadow series. It is also an interesting item for independent designers to copy. Whether this is true or not, the similarities are remarkable. Instead of the extravaganza found on the Shadow-armor, the Angel suit design and appearance is made to be as shiny, bright and pure as possible. This has attracted a lot of customers not ordinarily interested in wearing armor. The Angel armor is fashionable amongst the upper classes on Calypso.

sources.name: Chronicle Armor thigh-guards (female)
sources.description: The Chronicle armor is a dedicated gladiator armor, used by the famous Earth gladiators. The armor is designed by the champion Pompeii Max, who still has the record of 221 matches, with no defeats. Several sets were imported to Calypso right before the robot wars, in an attempt to introduce the noble gladiator sport to the colony. This cut-resistant adm-alloy suit is very protective against most close combat attacks with edged weapons – even the feared Gladiator swords have difficulties inflicting serious damage to a wearer.

sources.name: Hunter Armor thigh-guards (female)
sources.description: The Hunter-series of armor is a product designed by Sollomate for the would-be hunters on Calypso. It is also one of the most copied designs adapted by several small time local constructors. The armor is very flexible given its protection levels. Its fiber-plates are easily replaced when damaged. The color-scheme was developed with the natural scenery of Calypso in mind, increasing the wearers’ level of camouflage.

sources.name: Improved Hunter Armor thigh-guards (female)
sources.description: One of the most common armors on Calypso, the venerable Hunter armor, was made in an anniversary edition to celebrate the Project Entropia venture. The designer of choice was Nicolette D’Armstrong-Down, who is responsible for several very successful altered armors. The improved Hunter thigh-guards was a great success, with its fiber-resin inlays and very efficient cooling system that always keeps the wearer at a constant temperature. The reflective pseudo-camouflage layer of Samsadine™ enhances its protective abilities further. Although somewhat hard to find these days, it is still a very sought after armor, especially by women that hunt.

sources.name: Improved Shogun Armor thigh-guards (female)
sources.description: Protecting ones thighs is important, and its more physical aspects are something that LM/FCP decided to deal with. The Liam Marcus Firm of Comfortable Protections added a layer of MaxiAlloy-weave, surrounded by a TwinFiber Super-line. The result was remarkable, and very well received. Unfortunately, the process of refining the MaxiAlloy did make the thigh-guards very expensive, which in turn killed production after only a short while. This makes the improved Shogun thigh-guards a rare item.

sources.name: Improved Vigilante thigh-guards (female)
sources.description: The ever-resilient designer Nicolette D’Armstrong-Down is the designer behind this armor, which also doubles as a fashion garment. The original Vigilante thigh-guards is a very good piece of armor, and has appeared in different media and on the catwalks. The improved version is even more than that. The armor is provided with very comfortable multi-foam that supplies an instant body-fit to the wearer and every wearer gets their name etched in a platinum plate wherever they desire.

sources.name: Modified Shadow Armor thigh-guards (female)
sources.description: The eccentric and flamboyant designer Di-Yomeran DeWille once made a very limited series of the exclusive Shadow armor. The Lucky Carcasses Mercenary League asked if DeWille was willing to produce 100 sets of modified Shadow armor for the Leagues member roster. DeWille accepted the challenge and began his brilliant work. The already superb Shadow armor got an extra layer of multi-reflexive BarrioMetronics™, a very rare liquid spray used on space vessels, and ordinarily not available outside military channels. The multi-alloys were injected with a liquid super coolant, making the parts very resistant to burn attacks. The entire armor set was also sprayed with the anti-corrosive NoAcidic™. Every suit of armor was handmade by Di-Yomeran DeWille and his trusted apprentices, taking several years to make. Unfortunately, just before DeWille was to begin manufacturing the Shadow helmets, he vanished into thin air. No one has ever seen him since. As the League later dispersed due to internal difficulties, several of these suits also went missing. Sometimes they turn up at different local marketplaces, sometimes on corpses in the wilderness of Calypso. One should know however, that this series of armor is truly exquisite and extremely rare to find.

With its distinctive look and great protection, this prestigious armor is a coveted item for any warrior. Very few suits have ever made it to Calypso, and haven’t been awarded to anyone since the battle of Yadayat in the Baltran system.

sources.name: Sentinel Armor thigh-guards (female)
sources.description: The Federal Empire launched several special operations teams during the end of the first robot war. These teams were equipped with the best armor the empire had available. Several troopers did however succumb as the armor lacked the vital protection against the robots’ devastating laser fire. The teams, all members of the Grey Company of the SIF, or Special Incursion Forces, praised the armor’s excellent projectile and impact resistance, as well as its ability to endure extensive punishment from shrapnel. Also in the instance of hand-to-hand combat the armor performed well, withstanding most close combat assaults.

sources.name: Settler Armor thigh-guards (female)
sources.description: The DuraTekk Settler armor is a common sight on Calypso. It is cheap and versatile. Every citizen that has any notion about venturing out into the wilderness should have this armor at least. DuraTekk is distraught by the fact that the Settler is one of the most copied designs ever on Calypso, due to its ease to manufacture locally.

sources.name: Shadow Armor thigh-guards (female)
sources.description: The Shadow-series is nothing less than an example of Sollomates engineering genius. The dark camouflage, together with its terrific protection level and flexible materials, makes this one of the most advanced piece of armor on Calypso. Everything about it oozes perfection – the multi-layered liquid fiber-weave interwoven with high-density multi-alloys is just truly state-of-the-art. Even if the design is very complex and advanced, this doesn’t stop the professional local armor manufacturers to make their own ‘Calypso Versions’ of this work of genius.

The dark camouflage, together with its terrific protection level and flexible materials, makes this one of the most advanced piece of armor on Calypso. Everything about it oozes perfection – the multi-layered liquid fiber-weave interwoven with high-density multi-alloys is just truly state-of-the-art. Even if the design is very complex and advanced, this doesn't stop the professional local armor manufacturers to make their own ‘Calypso Versions' of this work of genius.

Several neo-designs have also been utilized when designing this masterpiece in armor technology. Its popularity is far greater than its availability on Calypso. This has also spawn several pirate designs of the Shogun suite, some local customize experts even makes superior versions.

sources.name: Supremacy Thigh Guards (F,L)
sources.description: The Supremacy armor is the next-generation protection of the well-known and respected Shadow armor series. Made by the same manufacturer, Supremacy offers a better protection level all over the board, with very few weaknesses. Its temperate super-alloy coating is a delight to see working together with the very comfortable shock-absorbers resting against the wearers body. The Supremacy's high production values will render it a spot among the higher echelon of armor suits, when great protection is an absolute necessity in order to survive.

sources.name: Vain Armor thigh-guards (female)
sources.description: The Vain armor is an ancient and revered suit of armor from Earth. It was at first an exclusive suit designated to the Federal Imperial Righteous Guard. It is very effective against projectile and close combat attacks, as these were the dominant weapon types that existed at this time. Former Federal Calypso Minister Xavyir Rugarnia’s personal bodyguard brought a few examples of this armor to Calypso. Also, a few of the old noble families from before the first robot war obtained their own sets, to show off their status on the new world. Most of the armor sets were lost during the war and the ravaging robots destroyed many suits.

sources.name: Warrior Armor thigh-guards (female)
sources.description: K’Ger made the Warrior armor as a response to Chikaras Dragon armor-design. The Warrior-series is a very well engineered piece of protection, based on an energy-absorbing super-alloy weave. Instead of marketing this armor as an exclusive suit, K’Ger aimed directly for people living in a hostile world – the mercenaries and guns-for-hire. This group often demands alterations, something Chikara does not acknowledge. This fact has made the Warrior a prime choice with several local armor constructors to copy and enhance, to facilitate the customer base.
